features: ✅ 4K Ultra HD Action Camera for Stunning Clarity: Capture every adventure in 4K resolution with this WiFi sports camera, offering crystal-clear video quality at 30FPS. Perfect for YouTubers, bikers, and extreme sports enthusiasts looking to document their thrills in high-definition.

✅ 170° Wide Angle Lens for Full Coverage: This action camera with 170-degree wide-angle lens provides a broad, immersive view. Ideal for helmet cameras, bike riding, stunt recordings, and travel videos—get the full picture of your experience!

✅ 98FT Waterproof – Capture Underwater Adventures: With a robust waterproof design, this underwater action camera can withstand depths of up to 98 feet. Perfect for swimming, diving, and water sports, allowing you to record stunning footage in wet conditions.

✅ WiFi Connectivity for Easy Sharing & Control: Seamlessly connect your 4K camera to your smartphone or tablet using WiFi for quick remote control and easy sharing of your content. Great for vloggers, action sports enthusiasts, and content creators who need to share footage on-the-go.

✅ Compact & Versatile – Perfect for Sports & Adventure: Lightweight and portable, this action camera is ideal for recording bike rides, stunt performances, and any extreme adventure. Comes with multiple mounts for helmets, bikes, and more—your perfect sports action recorder.
